cases.question: How can I improve on my spending expenses?
cases.answer:
- Review your spending categories to identify areas where you can cut back. Your current expenses include categories like Food & Drink, Bills & Utilities, Shopping, and others, all under 1k. 
- Create a monthly budget to track your expenses and ensure you live within your means. This will help you see where your money goes and where you can save.
- Focus on categories with higher spending. For example, if your spending on Food & Drink is significant, consider meal planning or cooking at home more often.
- Consider your discretionary spending, such as Entertainment and Travel, and evaluate if those expenses can be reduced or eliminated.
- Regularly review your insurance policies to ensure they are necessary and affordable. Spending more than 15% of your income on insurance may not be ideal.
- Establish an emergency fund of at least 3 to 6 months of expenses to provide a buffer during unexpected situations, which can help you avoid unnecessary spending in emergencies.
